verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal is a public IP-office service with online documentation, so publishing an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs index is a fair question and the axis applies. A direct probe returned HTTP 404 for /llms.txt, and none of the documentation items describe any agent-oriented docs. The listed pages only cover patent, trademark and design procedures.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
